# External dependency

Clone https://github.com/emmadcle/pyeogpr into `external/pyeogpr`, checkout `7c470644f33cc08ca934e0e44f3808b17aaf07f5`, and apply `docs/pyeogpr_local_patch.diff` following [the reproduction guide](../docs/reproducibility.md).
